name: modify-service-status-v1

attributes.m$K8sThreatMatrix: Lateral Movement::ARP poisoning and IP spoofing

description: determines which subjects can modify the services/status subresource, letting them set status.loadBalancer.ingress.ip to an address they control and intercept traffic sent to the service (CVE-2020-8554)
remediation: Remove update and patch on services/status from the role, and grant them only to the controllers that reconcile load balancer state, such as the cloud controller manager or a bare metal load balancer like MetalLB. Avoid wildcard resources and */status entries in roles bound to workloads or users.
